name: finite_time_row_consolidation_sweep
description: Tests whether row patterns consolidate to a stable single owner within a fixed presentation budget under the minimal signed-spike model (no budget, refractory=0, cap=thr/3). Sweeps seeds x dwell x schedule, plus a membrane-noise ablation, to quantify seed sensitivity and time-to-stable-owner.
hypothesis: Consolidation is seed-symmetry-limited: baseline (noise=0) leaves many patterns split ~0.5; a small local membrane noise breaks the symmetric ties so inhibition + signed learning amplify a consistent owner within ~200 presentations per pattern.
